$comment: Developer machines. Layer 3 of 5. HEADLESS=false belongs in your .env, not here - this file is shared.
$comment_mfa: IMAP against the mailbox label, because it needs no browser and so works headless and on Linux - the gmail-profile/gmail-cdp providers drive Gmail's own JS UI, need a display, and depend on markup that has broken repeatedly. INTERIM: an IMAP credential reaches the whole mailbox rather than one label, so gmail-api is still the production target. Trade-off and removal condition in docs/poc/mfa-gmail.md. Override per run with MFA_PROVIDER=gmail-profile.
